sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Claustrophobia is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Haven't seen you in a while. I was just talking about you with my friend, talking about clever youth... He told me a story about some amateur soldiers who went raiding into the old tunnels. One got spooked by a noise and started shooting everywhere, another one threw a bad grenade and killed everyone in their group. Turns out my comrade didn't even need a tripwire in the end. Disappointing, he said. If you don't want to find yourself in a similar situation, take a shotgun and go to those tunnels at the chemical plant. If you can handle the enemy in such conditions, then cramped space will become your ally."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate any 5 targets in the old cellars while using a shotgun on Factory

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- 25,400 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.03
- 89,000 Roubles
  - 93,450 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 97,900 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Burris FullField TAC30 1-4x24 30mm riflescope
"Alive and well, I see? Well, now you're the apex predator in those dungeons."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
In this quest you have to kill any 5 targets in the underground on Factory while using shotguns. Only the targets have to be in the area for the kills to count towards the quest.

The only area that doesn't count is beneath the tank containers.
